correctness.rationale: For each homogeneous row \(U_N\), \(\|U_N\|_{\mathcal S_1}\le D_d(N)|a_N|\sqrt{N+1}\), proving trace-norm convergence. Finite compression triangularity yields the determinant and power traces. Transverse monomial lines give the cumulative-sum equation \((\lambda-a_i)S_i=\lambda S_{i-1}\). The last repeated diagonal index leaves exactly one eigenvector on each line, hence one Jordan block whose size is the repeat count. A compact tail with no matching eigenvalue is invertible after subtracting \(\lambda I\), carrying the finite-head Jordan diagram to the full space. Decreasing consecutive coefficient ratios prove pairwise resonance for \(a_N=(N+1)q^N\). The standalone exact-arithmetic checker verified 16 finite Jordan-nullity assertions; it is auxiliary, not an infinite proof.
